Method of Attack: DLL Hijacking to gain persistence by abusing Microsoft Distributed Transaction Control (msdtc) service to load malicious DLL
Uses ICMP tunneling for covert command-and-control communication
Malicious DLL dropped in Windows System folder and loaded by legitimate Windows service msdtc.exe
Remote command execution via ICMP packets with specific sequence numbers
Discoverer: Trustwave principal security researcher Rodel Mendrez
Attack Vector: Dropping malicious DLL (oci.dll) in Windows System folder with system privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Network: ICMP Type=8, Sequence Number: 1234|1235|1236, Data size: 788 bytes
